values.note: 'Camping fees are $5/night for each site. Fees are payable at the campground.'
8 primitive sites 'nestled along rock outcroppings' on Forest Road 91 near the Otter Creek Wilderness.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bear-heaven-campground ('8 available sites are nestled along rock outcroppings'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Fees paid at the campground; check-out 1 p.m. Open 24 hours during the open season.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/bear-heaven-campground ('Maximum length of stay is 14 days', 'Check-out time is 1:00 p.m.', 'Fees are payable at the campground'), read 2026-10-21

note: High-elevation campground.  Not specifically designed for RVs, but online videos suggest that at least a few of the sites should be able to accommodate a camper van. --Claude
summary: FS page read: confirmed $5/night; added 8 primitive sites, vault toilet, no potable water, 14-day limit. FCFS/no-reservation (derived) left: the page implies it (fees paid at the campground) but does not say so. Not stated: season dates, rig length. Note trimmed (FCFS line duplicates booking).
flags: Criteria: the FS page calls it 'a small primitive campground' and gives no vehicle length; our own note says only that 'a few of the sites should be able to accommodate a camper van'. Nothing official says a 23-ft motorhome fits; inclusion_evidence rests on one listing's ~30 ft. A human should decide.
